pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks seeded rows are 0 and done=2 is rejected.
'AC-2' test checks / and /?view=open list only open items in id order.
'AC-3' test marks 3 and 1 done and checks ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' test checks all three items in id order, with the done one marked.
'AC-5' test asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /, with the current view in <strong>, not a link.
'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__; src uses Object.hasOwn.
'AC-7' test covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views on an empty table.
traffic/routes.json lists both views; 'AC-8' test imports it and checks them. The traffic checker now accepts query routes, with a test for that.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's decisions: it opens on open items and uses a query parameter. Nothing extra beyond the traffic-checker regex change, which the PR discloses and AC-8 needs.
All 8 acceptance items and all 6 state-table rows have named tests. The spec was added in the same change and no later commit edited it.

I couldn't run the tests here because vitest is not installed. I read them instead, and they assert behaviour and would fail on broken code. The existing tests in test/index.test.js are unchanged. The traffic.test.js fake-app edit only adds the query string to the recorded path.
README describes the open, done and all views. The traffic route format is not documented elsewhere.
The query uses fixed strings from a whitelist (no injection), and the Object.hasOwn check blocks __proto__. The empty-table check is correct.
Titles stay escaped. The view value is whitelisted and never echoed. No secrets.
Server-rendered HTML with a plain nav and no CSS or UI framework files in the diff; the states are verified by tests.
The diff has no client-side UI flow beyond links, and the PR says no browser was available.

The title and claims match the diff: the 400 behaviour, the traffic checker change, the test change, and the migration all check out. Claims about CI and the reviewer can't be checked from the repository.
